steps.title: Announcements — list, create, edit, delete, audience and scheduling
steps.goal: A leader with `announcements.create` writes an announcement at `/o/[orgSlug]/announcements/new` (title, body, audience group from the church's `audience_groups`, publish now or at a future date in the church's timezone, optional expiry, pinned, push on/off), sees it in the `/o/[orgSlug]/announcements` list with its state (Scheduled / Active / Expired) and a Push column that reads the `notifications` outbox row the DB trigger `app.on_content_publish` created ("Queued — delivered by the push dispatcher (step 3.6)"), edits it at `/o/[orgSlug]/announcements/[id]/edit` with `announcements.edit`, and deletes it with `announcements.delete` (the trigger cancels a queued push). Plain members see only published, unexpired announcements in their audience (RLS). A no-op `afterContentPublish()` stub in `src/lib/push/after-publish.ts` marks the single call site that step 3.6 turns into the synchronous push dispatch. No uploads, no bulletins (3.5b), no push sending (3.6).

## Goal
When you finish, a church leader holding `announcements.create` opens `/o/<slug>/announcements/new`, writes a title and body, picks the audience from the church's `audience_groups` (the six system groups first — All attendees, Members, Non-member attendees, Youth, Men, Women — then custom groups), chooses "Publish now" or a future date and time in the church's timezone, optionally sets an expiry, pins it, leaves "Send a push notification" on or turns it off, and saves. The row lands in `announcements`; the database trigger `app.on_content_publish` (step 1.3a) inserts one `notifications` row (`kind = 'announcement'`, `scheduled_for = publish_at`) when `push` is true — nothing in this step sends anything. The list at `/o/<slug>/announcements` shows every announcement with its state (Scheduled, Active, Expired), the audience name, pinned marker and a Push column that reads the outbox row: "Queued — delivered by the push dispatcher (step 3.6)". `announcements.edit` holders edit at `/o/<slug>/announcements/[id]/edit`; `announcements.delete` holders delete (the trigger `app.cancel_notifications_on_delete` cancels a still-queued push). Members without any `announcements.*` permission can open the list and see only what RLS lets them see (published, not expired, in their audience) with no controls. Step 3.5b adds bulletins; step 3.6 replaces the stub `afterContentPublish()` with the real dispatcher.

## Inputs / prior state
- Step 3.1 built the org shell and guards — reuse, never reshape: `src/lib/auth/require-org.ts` (`requireOrgMember(slug)` → `OrgContext` with `org`, `membershipStatus`, `personId`, `householdId`, `permissions`, `isSuperAdmin`, `writable`; read the file for the exact org-id field name — 2.1a/3.1 disagree between `ctx.org.orgId` and `ctx.org.org_id`), `requirePerm(ctx, perm | perms[])` (array = any-of), `requireWritable(ctx)` (throws `organization_suspended`), `isWritable(ctx)`; `src/features/org/nav.ts` (`NAV_ITEMS` with a commented "3.5 Announcements/Bulletins" placeholder), `src/features/org/Dashboard.tsx` (the "Active announcements" card carries `TODO(3.5)`), `src/features/org/org-context.tsx`, `StatusBanner`; `src/lib/actions/result.ts` (`ActionResult<T>`), `src/lib/supabase/errors.ts` (`toActionError`), `src/lib/env.ts` (`publicEnv()`), `src/lib/supabase/server.ts` (user-scoped server client). Server Actions receive `orgSlug`, re-run `requireOrgMember` + `requirePerm`, validate with Zod, write with the USER client, return `ActionResult`.
- Steps 3.3a/3.3b (`src/features/sermons/*`) show the house style for list pages, forms (RHF + `zodResolver`, shadcn/ui, `sonner`), confirm dialogs and action tests. Copy the patterns, not the files.
- `@church/domain` (1.6a/1.6b): `schemas/announcement.ts` → `announcementSchema` (`title` 1–160, `body` ≤ 10000, `audience_group_id` nullable uuid, `document_id` nullable uuid, `publish_at` datetime — future allowed, `expires_at` nullable and `> publish_at`, `pinned` default false, `push` default true); `permissions.ts` (`hasAnyPerm`, `PERMISSION_LABELS`); `dates.ts` (`todayInZone`, `DEFAULT_TIMEZONE`); `errors.ts` (`toDomainError`, `errorMessageFor`); `audiences.ts` (`SYSTEM_AUDIENCE_GROUPS` — the six system group names/kinds in order).
- `@church/db` (1.7a, every helper takes the client first): `queries/announcements.ts` — `listAnnouncements(db, orgId, { includeScheduled, includeExpired })` ordered `pinned desc, publish_at desc`, `getAnnouncement(db, id)`, `insertAnnouncement(db, row)`, `updateAnnouncement(db, id, patch)`, `deleteAnnouncement(db, id)`, `listNotificationStatus(db, orgId)` (reads `notifications` by `(kind, ref_id)`); `queries/audience-groups.ts` — `listAudienceGroups(db, orgId)` (system rows first, then custom by name); `queries/settings.ts` — `getSettings(db, orgId)` (for `timezone`); `keys.ts` — `queryKeys.announcements.list(orgId, filters)`, `.announcements.feed(orgId)`. Read the real signatures first; extend additively (optional parameter, own test) only when unavoidable and record it in HANDOFF.
- Database facts that decide behaviour (read `supabase/migrations/9999_init.sql` sections (3), (5), (7), (8) for `announcements` and `notifications`): `announcements` columns `id, org_id, title, body, audience_group_id null, document_id null, publish_at default now(), expires_at, pinned, push default true, push_enqueued_at, created_by, updated_by`; RLS select = member ∧ published ∧ not expired ∧ `app.user_in_group(audience_group_id)` OR any `announcements.*`; insert `announcements.create`; update `announcements.edit`; delete `announcements.delete`; `notifications` select = `announcements.*` managers. `app.user_in_group(null)` is true (an announcement with `audience_group_id = null` reaches everyone). Trigger `announcements_on_content_publish` (after insert or update) inserts a `notifications` row when `push` is true and `publish_at` is not null and no non-cancelled row exists for `(kind, ref_id)`, stamping `push_enqueued_at`; `announcements_cancel_notifications_on_delete` sets queued/claimed rows to `cancelled`.
- Founder decisions that apply: decision 4 — the permission mapping ships as the default (`announcements.create` creates, `.edit` edits, `.delete` deletes; nothing else unlocks these pages); decision 7 — "only `suspended` blocks writes; `past_due` = banner only" (`requireWritable` before every write; the banner is 3.1's). Orchestrator decision 7 fixes the ordering: "3.5 ships first: publishing inserts rows and the DB trigger enqueues `notifications` rows; the UI shows 'queued, delivered by the push dispatcher (step 3.6)'. 3.6 then adds `src/lib/push/*`, wires the publish Server Actions to call `dispatch()` synchronously after enqueue". Use that sentence as the Push column text.

## Build
1. **Push stub** `apps/web/src/lib/push/after-publish.ts`: `export type AfterPublishResult = { dispatched: false } | { dispatched: true; summary: unknown }` and `export async function afterContentPublish(_input: { orgId: string }): Promise<AfterPublishResult> { return { dispatched: false }; }` with a comment "Step 3.6 replaces this body with the synchronous push dispatch; keep the signature." Every Server Action below that publishes calls it once after a successful write and ignores the result. This file is the ONLY thing under `src/lib/push/` in this step.
2. **Timezone helpers** `src/features/announcements/datetime.ts` (web-only; `@church/domain` stays Intl-only): `zonedInputToIso(input: 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm', tz): string` (build a `TZDate` from `@date-fns/tz` in `tz`, return `toISOString()`), `isoToZonedInput(iso, tz)` (inverse, minute precision), `formatInOrgZone(iso, tz, pattern)` using `date-fns` `format` on a `TZDate`. `@date-fns/tz` and `date-fns` come from the pnpm `catalog:` (1.1); add them to `apps/web/package.json` as `catalog:` if not present. Tests: a New York summer and winter instant round-trip, the spring-forward gap hour (`02:30` on the DST day maps forward, does not throw), and `Europe/Berlin` vs `America/New_York` for the same input differ by the expected hours.
3. **State derivation** `src/features/announcements/announcement-state.ts`: `deriveAnnouncementState(row: { publish_at, expires_at }, now = new Date()): 'scheduled' | 'active' | 'expired'` and `ANNOUNCEMENT_STATE_LABELS`. `scheduled` = `publish_at > now`; `expired` = `expires_at` set and `<= now`; else `active`. Table test with the boundary instants.
4. **Schema wrapper** `src/features/announcements/form-schema.ts`: `announcementFormSchema` = the FORM shape (`title`, `body`, `audience_group_id` uuid — required in the UI, see 5 —, `publish_mode: 'now' | 'schedule'`, `publish_at_local` (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm`, required when `schedule`), `expires_at_local` optional, `pinned`, `push`) and `toAnnouncementInput(form, tz, now)` that produces the object `announcementSchema` accepts (`publish_at = now.toISOString()` for `now`; ISO via `zonedInputToIso` otherwise; `expires_at` null or ISO; `document_id: null`). Server Actions validate the RESULT with `announcementSchema` from `@church/domain` (single source of truth), never the form schema alone.
5. **AudienceGroupSelect** `src/features/announcements/AudienceGroupSelect.tsx` (client; shadcn `Select`): options = `listAudienceGroups` result passed from the server page — system groups first in `SYSTEM_AUDIENCE_GROUPS` order, a separator, then custom groups; default value = the system group with kind `everyone` ("All attendees"). The UI never writes `audience_group_id = null`: every announcement is stored against a group row (the `everyone` system group is the "no restriction" choice) so audience derivation and the fan-out in `srv_audience_user_ids(group, org)` follow one rule. Rows that already have `null` (created elsewhere) display as "Everyone". Helper text under the select: "Members are matched by the directory: sex, age and membership status decide Youth, Men, Women and Members (ages are set in Settings)". Custom groups are created in step 5.5 — show the separator only when custom rows exist.
6. **AnnouncementForm** `src/features/announcements/AnnouncementForm.tsx` (client; RHF + `zodResolver(announcementFormSchema)`): fields Title; Body (textarea, plain text, counter to 10000); Audience (component above); Publish — radio "Now" / "Schedule for", with a `datetime-local` input shown for "Schedule for", minimum = current minute in the org timezone, caption "Times are in <timezone>"; Expires (optional `datetime-local`, caption "Hidden from members after this time; the push is not affected"); Pinned (checkbox, "Pinned announcements stay at the top of the app feed"); Send a push notification (checkbox, default on, help "Members who installed the app and allow announcement notifications receive a push when this publishes. Editing later does not re-send."). Attach a document: render a disabled row "Available once Documents ship (step 5.4)" — `document_id` stays `null`; do NOT build a documents query. Submit label "Publish" / "Schedule" / "Save changes"; disabled while pending; field errors from `ActionResult.error.field`; `sonner` toast on success; when `!isWritable(ctx)` the whole form is read-only with 3.1's suspended explanation.
7. **Server Actions** `src/features/announcements/actions.ts` (`'use server'`), each: `requireOrgMember(orgSlug)` → `requirePerm` → `requireWritable` → `getSettings` for `timezone` → `announcementSchema.parse(toAnnouncementInput(...))` → user client → `ActionResult`:
   - `createAnnouncement(orgSlug, form)` — `announcements.create`; `insertAnnouncement(db, { ...input, org_id, created_by: user id, updated_by: user id })`; `revalidatePath('/o/<slug>/announcements')`, `afterContentPublish({ orgId })`, return `{ id, state }` so the client can toast "Published — push queued" / "Scheduled for <time>" / "Published — no push (turned off)".
   - `updateAnnouncement(orgSlug, id, form)` — `announcements.edit`; `getAnnouncement` first (404 → `not_found`); `updateAnnouncement(db, id, { ...input, updated_by })`; 0 rows updated → "You no longer have permission to edit announcements" (RLS refused); then `afterContentPublish` (turning `push` on after publication enqueues a fresh row via the trigger — the only way an edit causes a push; say so in the form help). Changing `publish_at` of an already-queued push does NOT move the queued `scheduled_for` in this step; show the notice "Push already queued — the dispatcher checks the publish time before sending (step 3.6)".
   - `deleteAnnouncement(orgSlug, id)` — `announcements.delete`; `deleteAnnouncement(db, id)`; 0 rows → permission message; `revalidatePath`.
   Map SQLSTATE 23514 (check violation, e.g. `expires_at` before `publish_at` if the DB has such a check) and 23503 (unknown `audience_group_id`) through `toDomainError` to field errors. Never import `src/lib/supabase/service.ts` here.
8. **Pages** (server components, `await params`): `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/announcements/page.tsx` — `requireOrgMember` (no `requirePerm`: members may read); compute `canCreate/canEdit/canDelete` from `hasAnyPerm`; managers (`announcements.*`) load `listAnnouncements(db, orgId, { includeScheduled: true, includeExpired: filter })` plus `listNotificationStatus(db, orgId)` and `listAudienceGroups`; plain members load the same query (RLS narrows it) and get no status column. Search param `?show=active|scheduled|expired|all` (default `all` for managers, `active` for members). `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/announcements/new/page.tsx` — `requirePerm(ctx, 'announcements.create')`, `AnnouncementForm` in create mode with the groups. `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/announcements/[id]/edit/page.tsx` — `requirePerm(ctx, 'announcements.edit')`, `getAnnouncement` (→ `notFound()`), form in edit mode prefilled via `isoToZonedInput`, Delete button (only with `announcements.delete`) opening a confirm dialog that names the title and says "A queued push notification is cancelled; sent notifications cannot be recalled".
9. **AnnouncementsTable** `src/features/announcements/AnnouncementsTable.tsx`: columns Title (pinned icon + link to edit when allowed), Audience (group name; "Everyone" for null), Publishes/Published (`formatInOrgZone`), Expires, State badge (`ANNOUNCEMENT_STATE_LABELS`), Push (managers only, `src/features/announcements/PushStatusBadge.tsx`: `push = false` → "Off"; no outbox row yet → "Not queued"; `queued` → "Queued — delivered by the push dispatcher (step 3.6)"; `claimed` → "Sending"; `sent` → "Sent <relative time>"; `failed` → "Failed"; `cancelled` → "Cancelled"; step 3.6 will extend this component with delivery counts and Retry — keep the status → label map in one exported function `pushStatusLabel(status, row)`), Actions (Edit / Delete). Empty states: "No announcements yet" with a Create button for `announcements.create`; the member view says "Nothing published for you right now".
10. **Nav and dashboard**: in `src/features/org/nav.ts` replace the commented 3.5 placeholder with `{ href: 'announcements', label: 'Announcements', icon: …, requires: undefined }` (visible to every member — the page itself decides what it shows); leave the Bulletins placeholder commented for 3.5b. In `src/features/org/Dashboard.tsx` turn the "Active announcements" count into a link to `/o/<slug>/announcements` and remove its `TODO(3.5)`; leave the bulletin card's `TODO(3.5)` for 3.5b.
11. **Tests** (2.1a Vitest harness, jsdom): `datetime.test.ts`, `announcement-state.test.ts`, `form-schema.test.ts` (`now` mode uses the injected clock; `schedule` converts in the org zone; `expires_at` before `publish_at` fails on `expires_at`), `actions.test.ts` with mocked `@church/db` modules and guards (create without `announcements.create` → `permission_denied`; suspended org → `organization_suspended`; 0 rows updated → the permission message; `afterContentPublish` called exactly once on create and update, never on delete), `AnnouncementsTable.test.tsx` (member view has no Push column; manager view renders the queued text), `nav.test.ts` update (Announcements visible with no permissions). If `apps/web/e2e/smoke.spec.ts` exists (3.7 may not have created it yet), add: signed-out `/o/unknown/announcements` → `/login?next=…`.
12. **Copy**: every user-facing string in English, sentence case, no jargon; the Push column text is verbatim from orchestrator decision 7.

## Constraints
- Web never holds elevated keys: no `service.ts` import anywhere in `src/features/announcements/`; all reads and writes go through the user client and `@church/db`. No raw `supabase.from(...)` in components or actions — add helpers to `packages/db` additively (with tests) if one is missing and record it in HANDOFF.
- Do not touch `supabase/` (no migrations; `9999_init.sql` may be frozen — check the HANDOFF ledger), `apps/web/vercel.json`, `proxy.ts`, `next.config.ts`, CSP, the sermons/share/users features, or `/admin`. Do not build bulletins (3.5b), uploads, documents (5.4), custom groups (5.5), push sending or the cron (3.6), or a mobile feed.
- Announcement body is plain text in Phase 1 — no markdown renderer, no HTML.
- Pins: Next 16.3, React 19.2.3, Zod 4.5, date-fns 4.4 + `@date-fns/tz` from the catalog, shadcn/ui components from `src/components/ui/*` (generate missing ones with the project's shadcn setup, do not hand-write). No new dependencies beyond those. No model names in commits.
- Never `supabase db push` or `supabase db reset`.

## Verify
- `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` → green, including the new `datetime`, `announcement-state`, `form-schema`, `actions`, `AnnouncementsTable` and `nav` suites.
- `pnpm --filter web build` → succeeds; the route list shows `/o/[orgSlug]/announcements`, `/o/[orgSlug]/announcements/new`, `/o/[orgSlug]/announcements/[id]/edit`.
- `git grep -n "lib/supabase/service" apps/web/src/features/announcements` → nothing; `git grep -n "afterContentPublish" apps/web/src` → `src/lib/push/after-publish.ts` plus exactly the create and update actions; `git grep -n "step 3.6" apps/web/src/features/announcements` → the Push label and the reschedule notice only.
- `ls apps/web/src/lib/push` → `after-publish.ts` only.
- With a live project (`apps/web/.env.local` pointing at the founder's step 2.5 project or the local seed) — as an `announcements.create` holder: create "Test announcement" for All attendees with push on → list shows Active + "Queued — delivered by the push dispatcher (step 3.6)"; in the Supabase SQL Editor `select kind, status, scheduled_for from public.notifications order by created_at desc limit 1` → `announcement | queued | <publish_at>`; schedule one for tomorrow 09:00 → state Scheduled, `scheduled_for` equals 09:00 New York in UTC; edit the first one's title → still one `notifications` row; delete it with an `announcements.delete` account → the row is `cancelled`; sign in as a plain member → only Active rows, no Push column, no buttons. Without a live project, write this script into `session_log.md` for the founder.

- `HANDOFF.md`: State checklist — tick the `announcements` part of "Web: announcements + bulletins" (bulletins remain open for 3.5b); feature table row "Announcements + push" → Web UI "create/edit/delete/schedule done (3.5a); push dispatch 3.6"; "Decisions" — "UI always stores an `audience_group_id` (the `everyone` system group means no restriction); `document_id` stays null until step 5.4; `afterContentPublish()` in `src/lib/push/after-publish.ts` is the single dispatch call site for 3.6"; "Deviations from plan" — anything you changed (additive `@church/db` helpers, a differing column name); a note for 3.5b ("reuse `PushStatusBadge`/`pushStatusLabel` and `formatInOrgZone`") and for 3.6 ("replace the stub body; extend `pushStatusLabel` with deliveries and Retry").
- Tick step 3.5a in `docs/TODO.md`; write `session_log.md`; commit `feat(web): announcements — list, create, edit, delete, audience and scheduling`; push `main`.
- If anything in the plan proves impossible or wrong (for example the trigger behaves differently from the description above), do the closest correct thing, record it in HANDOFF.md under "Deviations from plan", and report it in your final message.
done_when: `/o/[orgSlug]/announcements`, `/announcements/new` and `/announcements/[id]/edit` exist; new requires `announcements.create`, edit requires `announcements.edit`, delete requires `announcements.delete`, and the list opens for any active member (members see only published, unexpired rows in their audience and no controls).

"Schedule for" stores `publish_at` converted from the church's timezone (`organization_settings.timezone`), the row shows as Scheduled, and `expires_at` earlier than `publish_at` is rejected as a field error.
The audience select lists the six system groups first (All attendees default) then custom groups, and the UI never writes `audience_group_id = null`.
Deleting an announcement cancels its queued notification (status `cancelled`) and removes it from the list; editing does not create a second outbox row.
`apps/web/src/lib/push/after-publish.ts` exports the no-op `afterContentPublish({ orgId })` and it is called once by the create and update actions only.
`pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` and `pnpm --filter web build` are green; no file under `src/features/announcements/` imports the service client.
Nav shows Announcements to every member, the dashboard card links to the list, HANDOFF.md and docs/TODO.md are updated as described in Finish.

steps.notes: Skeleton step 3.5 is split into 3.5a (announcements) and 3.5b (bulletins) per orchestrator decision 13 — together they would exceed ~25 files and 3.5b needs 3.3b's uploader. Ordering follows orchestrator decision 7 (UI first, dispatcher in 3.6); the stub `afterContentPublish()` gives 3.6 one call site. Audience choice: the UI always stores a group id (the `everyone` system group), never null, so fan-out and RLS follow one rule — flagged as an open issue because DESIGN treats null as 'everyone'. `document_id` stays null until Documents ship (5.4). Announcements have no draft state (publish_at is not nullable per DESIGN); 'Scheduled' is the future-dated state. Editing publish_at after the push was queued does not move `scheduled_for` here; 3.6's dispatcher re-reads the row and reschedules. `@date-fns/tz` is used for the local→UTC conversion because `@church/domain` is Intl-only.

steps.title: Bulletins — This Sunday / Quarter presets, PDF/JPG/PNG upload, list, open, delete
steps.goal: A leader with `bulletins.upload` opens `/o/[orgSlug]/bulletins`, picks "This Sunday", "Quarter" or a custom date range (the presets compute `starts_on`/`ends_on` in the church's timezone), chooses a PDF, JPG or PNG up to 25 MiB and uploads it with the generic resumable uploader from step 3.3b along the exact-path flow (insert row with `publish_at = null` → tus upload to `{org_id}/bulletins/{bulletin_id}/{uuid}.{ext}` → finalize and publish). The list shows every bulletin with its date range, a "Current" badge for the one covering today, Open/Download through 1-hour signed URLs, a Push column (the DB trigger enqueues a `bulletin` notification when `push_on_bulletin` is on — founder decision 6) and Delete (the trigger enqueues the object into `storage_deletions`). Incomplete uploads can be resumed or discarded. Members see published bulletins read-only. No push sending (3.6).

A migration would make the behaviour exact and cheaper, but it is not required for Checkpoint B.

open_issues: Skeleton step 3.5 is split into 3.5a (announcements) and 3.5b (bulletins) per orchestrator decision 13; 3.6 depends on 3.5b. The assembler must repoint other groups: G13 5.4 `depends_on: 3.5` → `3.5a` (announcements' document link) and `3.5b` if it reuses the bulletin upload pattern; G10 3.7 → 3.6 unchanged.

3.5b adds a dependency on 3.3b (G8) that the skeleton did not list: it reuses `apps/web/src/features/uploads/{tus,ResumableUpload,upload-errors}` and `statObject` instead of writing a plain 25 MiB uploader (G8 asked for exactly this).

Audience semantics: DESIGN treats `announcements.audience_group_id = null` as 'everyone' (`app.user_in_group(null)` is true). 3.5a's UI always stores a group id and uses the `everyone` system `audience_groups` row for 'All attendees', so the fan-out and RLS follow one rule; null rows still render as 'Everyone'. If the orchestrator prefers null for 'everyone', change 3.5a Build 5 and the corresponding done_when item.

Names chosen because the docs are silent (later groups must reuse): `apps/web/src/lib/push/after-publish.ts` → `afterContentPublish({ orgId })` (3.5a stub, 3.6 body); `pushStatusLabel(status, row)` / `PushStatusBadge` in `src/features/announcements/`; `src/features/announcements/datetime.ts` (`zonedInputToIso`, `isoToZonedInput`, `formatInOrgZone`); `src/features/bulletins/{presets,form-schema,actions,UploadBulletinForm,BulletinsTable,OpenBulletin}`; `src/lib/push/{expo,dispatch,receipts,refs}.ts`, `src/lib/cron/{tick,storage-deletions,orphan-sweep}.ts`; `notificationTargetPath(kind, refId)` added to `@church/domain` `src/urls.ts` (G11 4.3 must route on `data.url` from it and create the Android channel `announcements`).

Additive `@church/db` helpers G9 asks the executing agents to add if 1.7a did not ship them: `getBulletin`, a `kind` filter on `listNotificationStatus` (or `listDeliveryCounts`), `cancelNotification`, `rescheduleNotification`, `resetNotificationForRetry`, `listPreferencesForUsers`, `listEnabledDevicesForUsers`, `removeObjects`, `findReferencedPaths`, minimal getters in `queries/calendars-events.ts` / `queries/surveys.ts` (modules G4 deferred to 5.3/6.1), and `extensionFor(mime)` in `@church/domain` `limits.ts`. `notification_deliveries` is not readable by `authenticated` (DESIGN §6), so per-notification delivery counts for the admin lists go through a permission-gated Server Action with the service client (3.6 Build 7). G14 6.2 (delivery status page) should reuse that action/query rather than opening RLS.

Proposed optional step 3.12 fixes both in SQL.

G2 (1.2) should confirm the final names so 1.7a's helpers and 3.6 agree.
